readings.moment: At the moment the temple struck ten
Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen
The temple struck eleven (Lina was still in the kitchen until after this)
At the moment the hall clock struck eleven

durations: The piano played from 10:48 to 11:01 by the kitchen clock: 13 minutes
The kitchen clock ran 15 minutes ahead of the temple bell when the temple struck ten (a quarter past ten against ten)
The kitchen clock ran 3 minutes ahead of the hall clock when the hall clock struck eleven (three minutes past eleven against eleven)
whereabouts: Rosa was in the kitchen and said she is always in the kitchen
Rosa did not sit down at any point while working in the kitchen
Rosa was in the kitchen when she heard Madame's piano and the hall clock
Madame was playing the piano from 10:48 to 11:01 by the kitchen clock
Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:37 by the kitchen clock
Lina sat by the stove in the kitchen
Lina stayed with Rosa in the kitchen until after the temple struck eleven
Madame wanted the master brought down for the toast
Rosa went up to the atelier to fetch the master for the toast
Rosa did not know the time she went up to the atelier
When Rosa found him, the master was on the floor by his bench under the long windows in the atelier
Rosa is now in the dining room
